== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Red 3 formerly had an astromech while Biggs is in play. The 2006 card supplies a nav computer only while Biggs pilots Red 3. The astromech substitution and piloting trigger are separate changes. The pilot +2, free locations and Old Times retrieval remain; the Phase One Rule preserves the once-per-control-phase take.
